facts.text: Lakemont Park officially opened in 1894, though some records claim 1893, marking the start of Central Pennsylvania’s oldest amusement park.
The original Lakemont Park featured gardens, a theatre, a lake, a picnic area, a carousel and a gravity railroad, a precursor to modern roller coasters.
In 2000, the park was renamed DelGrosso’s Amusement Park and has since grown into Central Pennsylvania’s preeminent amusement destination.
Lakemont sits east of I‑99 between Altoona and Hollidaysburg, yet its address is often listed as Altoona because the park lies within the city limits.
Locals remember the quirky tradition of feeding park fish popcorn by dumping leftover treats into the lake, a habit that still echoes in local lore.
